//: RETROFIT DEBT — numeric-egress coercions that existed when tools/numeric-egress-gate.mjs was written.
This is NOT a suppression list. It is the bill: every entry is a site where a contract-declared
numeric response field is assigned a literal fallback instead of being validated through
src/routes/v2/numeric-egress-guards.ts and OMITTED when the producer did not measure it.
THE LIST MAY ONLY SHRINK. The gate REDs on a NEW violation and equally on a STALE entry, so a site
can only leave this file in the same commit that fixes it. Removing an entry without fixing the code
REDs; fixing the code without removing the entry REDs. There is no silent exit.
Identity is file + key + normalised source snippet — NOT the line number. `line` is informational
and may drift; the gate does not read it.
To pay one down: replace the literal fallback with the matching guard (finiteNum / prob01 / nonNeg /
nonNegInt), OMIT the field when it returns undefined, and delete the entry here in the same commit.
WIDENED 2026-08-29 — the gate now also sees a substitution written as `cond ? real : LITERAL`
and one laundered through a local `const`/`let` before egress. Both forms were structurally
invisible before, which is why the site this gate's own header names as its motivating example
(`structural_certainty` 0.5 for a factor with no incoming edges, src/lib/factor-influence.ts:837)
was never on this list. 16 occurrences at 15 identities became visible and are pinned below.
`class: heuristic-limit` is NOT DEBT. It marks a site the gate flags but which is not a
fabrication — recorded here, with its reason, rather than silently exempted in the gate, because a
widened exemption hides real lies and a silent one cannot be reviewed. Do not 'fix' such a line.
Where two entries share file+key+snippet, the identity genuinely occurs twice in the file and the
gate compares COUNTS: both must be present, and `line` tells a human which is which.
A MEASURED ZERO IS NOT AN ABSENCE — the guards test finiteness and range, never truthiness.
